notes: Candidates are the skills-v2 siblings that share security vocabulary. Legacy skills are excluded. This is an unrun group evaluation specification; triggers.json supplies isolated binary expectations only. Required skills must be selected; any selection outside allowed is a false match. Ambiguous combined requests permit multiple skills.

queries.query: Audit this Go API for exploitable vulnerabilities and authorization bypass.
While adding a Go URL preview feature, prevent SSRF through DNS rebinding and redirects.
Secure cookie-authenticated Go POST handlers against CSRF.
Review the Go archive uploader for path traversal and decompression bombs.
We deploy many Go replicas with one encryption key. Check GCM nonce safety and key rotation.
Prevent SQL injection in this Go search endpoint with dynamic sort columns.
Threat model the trust boundaries in our Go payment webhook service.
Stop our Go telemetry from leaking credentials and personal data.
Harden Go session cookies and verify JWT issuer, audience, expiry and signing algorithm.
Can hostile dimensions overflow this Go upload allocation and crash the server? Audit the denial-of-service risk.
Fix a typed-nil error return in this Go library.
Preserve errors.Is and errors.As when adding context to Go errors.
Our Go snapshot aliases a map of slices; make the ownership contract correct.
Check int64-to-int32 narrowing overflow in a Go binary encoder.
Ensure each Go batch file closes per iteration and preserves cleanup errors.
Design Go worker-pool cancellation, goroutine ownership and channel shutdown.
Add testify assertions and unit tests to this Go parser.
Benchmark Go slice copying and analyze the allocation profile.
Run a dependency-only govulncheck scan for the Go module.
Wire gosec and govulncheck into GitHub Actions for a Go repository.
Review Go error wrapping and prevent raw credentials appearing in HTTP failure responses.
Add regression tests for the CSRF fix in this Go handler, including valid requests.
Review synchronized session revocation in Go for an authorization bypass under concurrent requests.
Review a Go function that reads a fixed local configuration file; focus on propagation of read and close errors.
Add request latency histograms and trace spans to this Go HTTP service.
Structured slog logging for our Go API is too noisy; reduce log volume and pick levels.
Our Go logs include bearer tokens and customer emails. Redact them before they reach the log pipeline.
Write a pgx query with placeholders to filter Go orders by status and date range.
Enable gosec in our .golangci.yml and tune its excludes.
Can a user read another tenant's invoice by changing the ID in the URL of this Go handler?
